description: This file defines the actor `MacNodeRuntime` that manages various system and application-level functionalities for a macOS-based node runtime. It includes methods for handling commands related to canvas, camera, location, system execution, permissions, and notifications. The code interacts with services such as `CanvasManager`, `CameraCaptureService`, and manages system interactions like running commands, handling approvals, and emitting events.

classes.name: MacNodeRuntime
classes.description: An actor managing system commands, permissions, and interactions with device services and system features for a macOS node runtime environment.

methods.description: Updates the main session key used for session management.

methods.description: Sets the callback function for emitting events.

methods.description: Main command handler that dispatches commands to specific handlers based on the command type.
